'''Togo Shrine''' is a shrine dedicated to {{ill|Tōgō_Heihachirō|en|Tōgō_Heihachirō|qid=Q296785|lt=Heihachiro Togo|1=Tōgō Heihachirō}}.

Other known shrines include the Nogi Shrine, which enshrines {{ill|Nogi_Maresuke|en|Nogi_Maresuke|qid=Q468122|lt=Nogi Maresuke|1=Nogi Maresuke}}, and the [[Kodama Shrines]], which enshrines {{ill|Kodama_Gentarō|en|Kodama_Gentarō|qid=Q72515|lt=Gentaro Kodama|1=Kodama Gentarō}}.

== Major Shrines ==
* {{ill|Tōgō Shrine|en|Tōgō Shrine|qid=Q1384780|lt=Tōgō Shrine|1=Tōgō Shrine}} -    Tkkyo
* {{ill|2=ja|Togo Shrine (Hanno)|ja|東郷神社 (飯能市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/2=ja|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to JA}}    – Saitama
* {{ill|2=ja|Tōgō Shrine (Fukutsu)|ja|東郷神社 (福津市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/2=ja|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to JA|1=Tōgō Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11528549}}  - Fukutsu, Fukuoka
